normal_orientation_method: Authoritative gate: per-object signed volume must be positive (all faces wound outward) - this asset is a union of overlapping solids, so a small residual of visibility-ray 'flipped' first hits is legitimate (rays entering the union interior through an overlap); the 22,500-ray test is kept as a supplementary metric with a 0.1% tolerance. Loop normals must be finite/unit.
